name: test-assistent-mcp-server
description: Test assistant MCP server for OpenCode — exposes classic test techniques and test heuristics as tools, backed by a local knowledge base.

tools.name: catalog_techniques
tools.description: List all classic test techniques (BVA, equivalence partitioning, decision table, pairwise, state transition, use case, error guessing).

tools.name: catalog_heuristics
tools.description: List all test heuristics (SFDPOT, FEW HICCUPPS, RCRCRC, quality criteria catalog, bug heuristics, test tours).

tools.name: generate_test_cases
tools.description: Generate concrete testcases for supported techniques (Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Pairwise Testing). Only returns testcases; the agent does the rest.

technique.description: The technique name: 'Boundary Value Analysis', 'Equivalence Partitioning', or 'Pairwise Testing'

inputs.description: Technique-specific inputs, e.g. {field: 'age', min: 0, max: 150} for BVA

tools.name: advise_technique
tools.description: Recommend techniques and heuristics for a described testing context via keyword analysis.

description.description: Free-text description of the testing context or problem

tools.name: checklist_for
tools.description: Produce a recommended test checklist (items) for a context, e.g. RCRCRC for regression after a bug fix.

context.description: The testing context, e.g. 'regression', 'exploratory testing', 'no specification'
